body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 3 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to each target.

surges.html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against one target.
One hit target suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: If you began with Lock on one target, you may transfer it to the other after resolving. If both were hit, the transfer ignores temporary concealment.
